title: Performance+
description: A modpack that adds performance and quality of life mods.
body: A modpack that adds performance and quality of life mods. This adds mods like sodium, lithium, continuity, enchantment descriptions, iris shaders(The modpack does not include any shaders, you will need to provide your own) ect. Currently avadable for 1.21.11 and 1.21.10
